sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: The file specifies in detail how (per the file) a BLS public key may be generated by users (per the file) via updated existing tools (per the file) and how they can (per the file) put the generated BLS (per the file) public keys into their vote accts for voting in Alpenglow. Per the file, it also describes in (per the file) detail the data structure changes needed. Those statements are the file’s claims, not a Sol.College measurement of a live cluster.

sections.heading: Motivation
paragraphs: Per the file, the Alpenglow SIMD (326) (per the file) described the new consensus protocol which is to be launched on Solana. Per the file, the protocol calls for efficient and safe aggregation of node votes to succinctly prove (per the file) certain state transitions can safely happen (as an illustration, 60% of the nodes voted to skip a slot). Per the file, the ed25519 signatures we (per the file) currently use are not (per the file) the best fit for (per the file) this purpose, so instead we is to be using the Boneh–Lynn–Shacham (per the file) (BLS) aggregate signature scheme to sign (per the file) Alpenglow votes. Per the file, however, the BLS public (per the file) key is entirely different (per the file) from an ed25519 public (per the file) key (as BLS operates (per the file) over a different elliptic (per the file) curve), so we can’t (per the file) naively reuse the current ed25519 (per the file) public keys in vote accts either. Per the file, each node must add a BLS (per the file) public key into their vote acct before the network makes possible Alpenglow so as to vote.

Per the file, we plan to implement (per the file) this by calling BLS (per the file) library from the vote (per the file) program, see "Alternatives Considered" (per the file) for comparison with other solutions. Per the file, since BLS verification is (per the file) expensive (around 1.15ms), each (per the file) verification will cost 34,500 CUs. Per the file, any Vote program instruction (per the file) that performs a BLS (per the file) verification will therefore add (per the file) 34,500 CUs per verification (per the file) on top of its baseline cost. Per the file, as a result, Vote (per the file) program instructions - which currently (per the file) all cost 2,100 CUs (per the file) - will have differentiated CU costs (per the file) depending on whether they include BLS verification.

Per the file, the updated CU values (per the file) are detailed in later sections. Per the file, note the 34,500 CUs (per the file) for BLS verification is to be consumed immediately before the (per the file) verification is performed. Per the file, currently the vote program (per the file) is allocated a budget (per the file) of 3,000 CUs in the node's builtin program cost modeling mechanism. sections.heading: Security Considerations
paragraphs: Per the file, the safety of BLS (per the file) votes in Alpenglow is (per the file) still guarded by the (per the file) ed25519 vote authority keypair, (per the file) so users are supposed (per the file) to safe guard it like before. Per the file, we need to have (per the file) the proof of possession (per the file) in the instruction inputs (per the file) so we can guard (per the file) against BLS rogue-key attack. Per the file, if anyone is allowed (per the file) to randomly choose a (per the file) public key, then an (per the file) attacker can select a (per the file) particular public key which (per the file) interacts with other participants' (per the file) keys so a forged (per the file) aggregate signature verifies even (per the file) though not all honest parties actually signed.
